item.title: Iran drone strike torches Kuwait-flagged tanker off Dubai
item.description: Iran struck and set fire to a Kuwait-flagged oil tanker Al-Salmi on Monday off the coast of Dubai, amid escalating tensions in the Gulf region.

item.title: Accelerated CCGT Response for Grid Demand - NS Energy
item.description: The combination of NEM Energy’s DrumPlusTM HRSG design and a diverter damper has shown the ability to switch-over from simple cycle to combined cycle at 100% gas turbine load for an F-class gas turbine, without the need for GT ramp down. This enables CCGT plant operators to respond more quickly to grid demands, as well as saving money and reducing emissions

item.title: Sedimentation: A Costly Threat to Hydropower - NS Energy
item.description: Sedimentation can pose a significant threat to hydropower development and reservoir sustainability. Here IWP&DC looks at how recent global experiences are trying to address this problem which has been described as ‘an economic haemorrhage’

item.title: Smarter Monitoring for Safer Tailings Dams - NS Energy
item.description: The safety of dams, particularly tailings dams, has become an increasingly critical topic due to the environmental, social, and economic risks associated with their failure. SAALG Geomechanics explores the monitoring systems used in tailings dams, their importance, and how technological advances and standardization in construction have helped improve the safety and sustainability of these infrastructures

item.title: AMLM acquires Higginsville Project in WA
item.description: American Lithium Minerals (AMLM) has acquired the Higginsville Gold Project, consisting of four prospecting licences in Western Australia (WA).

item.title: US grants ESA exemption for Gulf oil and gas activities
item.description: The Endangered Species Committee in Trump's administration has granted an exemption for oil and gas activities in the Gulf of America.

item.title: Advantage Capital closes investment in Medway Grid project
item.description: Advantage Capital has completed a $158m tax equity investment in the 250MW Medway Grid Energy Battery Storage project.

item.title: Subsea7 wins contract for Aseng gas monetisation project
item.description: Subsea7 has won a contract from Noble Energy EG, a subsidiary of Chevron, for subsea installation work on the Aseng gas monetisation project in waters off Equatorial Guinea.

item.title: GoldHaven begins drill targeting at Magno Project in BC
item.description: GoldHaven Resources has begun drill targeting for a 2026 exploration programme at its Magno Project in the Cassiar District of northern British Columbia (BC).

item.title: Zambia launches 300MW solar PV tender through CFIP scheme
item.description: Zambia has opened a call for proposals for solar PV projects with a combined capacity of up to 300MW, as part of the CFIP programme.
